title: fix(app-shell): the Studio list-view panel names the view by its display name, not its qualified name (objectui#13151)
body:
Fixes #13151

Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

On an object's nav item in Studio (Interfaces pillar), the list-view Properties panel (`ObjectListViewInspector`) headed itself with the view's qualified name whenever the stored view had no `label` or did not exist yet. The title fell back to `target.viewId` (OBJECT.KEY, for example `ux_walk_two_site_visit.default`), and the not-created and not-list sentences interpolated the same id.

## What changed

`packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectListViewInspector.tsx`:

- New local `listViewTitle(target, item, objectText, locale)`. It returns the item's own `label`, resolved as before, so a labelled view reads exactly as today. Without a label, it returns the object's display name plus the view's role: `engine.studio.inspector.listView.defaultTitle` ("{object} · Default view" / "{object} · 默认视图") for the object's default list view, else `engine.studio.inspector.listView.namedTitle` ("{object} · {view}") with the key the nav entry names the view by.
- The object's display name comes from `useNavTargetLabel()` called with `{ kind: 'object', objectName }`. That is the resolver the Studio nav rail already uses for a label-less entry. It reads the published label from `useMetadata().objects`, else the pending draft's label from `DraftTargetLabels` (the Interfaces pillar is mounted under that provider), and passes it through the app bundle's `objectLabel`. It sends no new request. The object's machine name is used only when nothing names the object.
- The not-created and not-list sentences use the same title. The `{view}` value is now quoted, with “…” in en and 「…」 in zh.
- The qualified name stays on the panel as a secondary line under the header (`data-testid="list-view-name"`, monospace, 10px, muted), shown only where it differs from the title. This is the styling Studio rows use for a machine name (`StudioNameLabel`: label primary, machine name secondary). `InspectorShell` has no subtitle slot, and none of its callers draws a machine name in the header (checked across every `InspectorShell` caller). So the line sits at the top of the panel body, and the shared shell stays outside this PR's file surface.
- What the panel writes, and where, is unchanged. `target.viewId` is still the save name. The copilot draft marks, the read-only notice and the canvas selection are untouched.

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` adds two new keys (`defaultTitle`, `namedTitle`). It also changes the en and zh values of `notCreated` and `notList`: only the quote marks are new, and the `{view}` placeholder is unchanged. All edits stay on the `engine.studio.inspector.listView.*` lines.

## Choices made against the dispatch hypotheses

- H1, measured. The panel's own inputs carry no display name: `target` holds only objectName, viewId and isDefault; `useObjectFields` returns only fields; `leaf.label` is the nav entry's text, which can be a label authored for the entry rather than the object's. The object label is already available through `useNavTargetLabel()` (the MetadataProvider cache plus the pillar's `_drafts` rows), with no new read.
- H2, object name. The title uses the singular display label, which is the one the nav rail uses, not the plural. A draft-only object's `_drafts` row carries only `label`, so a plural rung would miss the card's own case, an object created in Studio. Both locales use the separator ` · `, as Studio's other compound names do.
- H2, machine name. It is a secondary line in the panel body, not an `InspectorShell` subtitle prop. No such prop or caller pattern exists, and adding one would widen the shared shell beyond the claimed surface.

## Tests

The new `ObjectListViewInspector.displayTitle-13151.test.tsx` runs the real hook and the real panel over a real `MetadataClient` backed by an in-memory server. Its cases:

- An unlabelled default view, not yet created. The header is `Loan · Default view`. The notice contains “Loan · Default view” and not `acme_loan.default`. The machine-name line contains `acme_loan.default`.
- The same view in zh: `Loan · 默认视图` and 「Loan · 默认视图」.
- A draft-only object: it is absent from published metadata and its label comes from `DraftTargetLabels`. The header is `Site Visit · Default view`. This is the card's case.
- An object with no label anywhere: `acme_loan · Default view`.
- An unlabelled named view (nav `viewName: 'open'`): `Loan · open`.
- An unlabelled form view at the default name: the not-list sentence names “Loan · Default view”, not the id.
- CONTROL: a labelled view is headed by its label.

In `StudioDesignSurface.listViewInspector-11823.test.tsx`, two pins asserted the dotted id (`showcase_task.default`) in the not-created and not-list notices. They now assert “Task · Default view” (the object's label is "Task" and its nav entry is "Tasks") and the absence of the id. The save-name pins (`name: 'showcase_task.default'`) are unchanged and green, because the panel still writes to `target.viewId`.

Runs on head `f84fedd3c`, after merging `main` `8d4e45376`, which brought in objectui#13206's zh value in the same i18n file:

- The 8 files `ObjectListViewInspector.*` and `StudioDesignSurface.listViewInspector-*`: `Test Files 8 passed (8)`, `Tests 43 passed (43)`.
- 5 more Studio files that mount the panel through the pillar (`StudioDesignSurface.kanbanCardSelection-12725`, `StudioDesignSurface.leafColumnSelection-12725`, `StudioDesignSurface.selectionLeafScope`, `StudioDesignSurface.studioCanvasLeaf`, `DataPillar.inspectorBelongsToView-11781`): `Test Files 5 passed (5)`, `Tests 46 passed (46)`.

Ablation, on fix commit `9efe8d2d4` before the merge:

- Both source files were reverted to base `7d497de38` and the tests were kept. The on-disk blobs matched the base blobs, and the count of `listViewTitle` went from 2 to 0.
- Result: `Tests 9 failed | 5 passed (14)`. All 7 new cases and both re-pointed 11823 pins were red.
- Direction: the CONTROL case's label assertion stayed green on base, because a labelled view is headed by its label before and after. It went red only on the new machine-name line.
- The files were restored with `git checkout HEAD --`. The restore is proven by an empty `git diff HEAD` and by both blobs matching HEAD's.

## Gates (local, head f84fedd3c)

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell lint`: exit 0 with 0 errors. The warnings already existed and none is on a changed line.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0, after building the dependency closure. `tsconfig.test.json` lists both touched test files.
- `pnpm check:i18n-designer-parity`: exit 0, "Every en row has a zh row, and every shared row carries the same placeholders."
- `pnpm check:i18n-dead-keys` (report only): the new keys are not among its candidates. `pnpm check:i18n-keys`: exit 0.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: exit 0 with 0 new citations. `pnpm check:control-bytes`: exit 0.
- Changeset gates, all exit 0: `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, `node scripts/check-changeset-overwrite.mjs`, `pnpm check:changeset-claims`, `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals`.
- Test-file gates, all exit 0: `pnpm check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`.
- Left to CI: the full `pnpm test`, repo-wide lint and every other gate family.
- NOT MEASURED: a real-browser render of the panel, because no backend was booted. The DOM-level pins above stand in for it.

## Acceptance notes

- `.changeset/13151-list-view-title.md`: `'@object-ui/app-shell': patch`.
- No export, prop, type member or language-pack key changes. `metadata-admin/i18n.ts` is not on the package entry.
- Observation, not filed (an unreproduced read-only inference): the runtime object page's delete-view confirm names the view `targetView?.label || vid` (`handleDeleteView` in `ObjectView.tsx`). It only applies to saved views, which are created with a name, so no path was found that reaches it with an unlabelled view. Carrier: none.
